crossRefs.note: “Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and…
Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it, and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit…
When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”
Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break…
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
“Son of man, what is the vine tree more than any tree, the vine-branch which is among the trees of the forest?
Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down…
He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and…
Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear…
but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves…

translations.web: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.
translations.bsb: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
translations.kjv: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
translations.asv: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
